definitions: Nickname for Gabriel García Márquez, a Colombian novelist, short-story writer, screenwriter, and journalist, known for his works like 'One Hundred Years of Solitude'.
A surname of Russian origin, notably associated with Naum Gabo, a prominent sculptor of the Constructivist movement.
examples: Many refer to Gabriel García Márquez simply as Gabo.
The exhibition featured several pieces by Naum Gabo.
